case_number: 2025 INSC 432; CIVIL APPEAL NO. ______________ OF 2025 [@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 20474 OF 2019]

parties.respondent: The Secretary, Worth Trust Workers Union

summary: Applicability of Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 to trust-run factories; commercial activities generating surplus trigger bonus liability; exemption under Section 32(v)(a), (c) rejected; trust not akin to Indian Red Cross or non-profit institution for profit exclusion; industrial dispute over bonus and ex-gratia; Tribunal award upheld; High Court modification on bonus-exgratia adjustment sustained; appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment of High Court upheld.
